title: Juicy Molten Italian Carrots Orecchiette
description: A vegan-friendly Italian dish featuring carrots and orecchiette, cooked to perfection on a robata-grill and shaped like nigiri, with a buttery and molten texture.

ingredients.name: carrots
ingredients.notes: peeled and sliced into 1/4 inch thick rounds

instructions: Preheat the robata-grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the orecchiette according to package instructions and set aside.
In a large bowl, toss the sliced carrots with olive oil, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Grill the carrots on the robata-grill for 5 minutes per side, or until they are tender and lightly charred.
In a small saucepan, melt the vegan butter over low heat and add the minced garlic.
Add the cooked orecchiette to the saucepan and toss with the garlic butter until the pasta is well coated.
To shape the orecchiette like nigiri, place a small amount of pasta in the center of a carrot slice and shape into a ball.
Serve the juicy molten Italian carrots orecchiette hot, garnished with nutritional yeast if desired.
Repeat the process with the remaining ingredients.
Let the dish cool for a few minutes before serving.
